_comment: PRODUCTION deploy config for We Stay Fit on the SHARED goarrive project.
PRODUCTION-DEPLOY-PATH-1 (#365 6075293313). Used only by the operator runbook
docs/westayfit/ops/production/RUNBOOK_WSF_PRODUCTION_DEPLOY_1.md, which copies
this file into a checkout of the reviewed candidate (never operational main)
and runs .github/wsf-production/preflight.mjs against it first.
It exists because firebase.json is the GoArrive default: its hosting has no
site (it resolves to goarrive.web.app), it carries GoArrive's `default`
functions codebase, and it declares Storage. Any WSF command through it is
one typo away from GoArrive.
Declared here and nothing else: the `westayfit` functions codebase and
Firestore rules/indexes. NO hosting (Lovable serves app.westay.fit), NO
storage (WSF stores no Cloud Storage object). So `--only functions:westayfit`
cannot reach GoArrive's functions, and no target here can reach
goarrive.web.app, even by mistake.
Firestore is declared because the WSF rules section must be live for the
client's direct reads, but the ruleset is SHARED: the runbook deploys
`firestore:rules` only after the live ruleset, re-read just before, is shown
equal to main outside its WSF section. The two WSF composite indexes are
created with gcloud; the pre-flight refuses `firestore:indexes`, which would
also create any of main's indexes that production lacks.
Mirrors firebase.westayfit.staging.json minus hosting. Keep the functions
entry in sync with it.
